program_name: Master of Engineering in Structural Integrity

requirements.general_text: Entry Level and Requirements For Local Students   A Bachelor Degree in Engineering Technology or Bachelor Degree from Universiti Kuala Lumpur with minimum CGPA of 2.5 or; A Bachelor Degree in related sciences or technical field with minimum CGPA of 2.5 from local or overseas university as approved by Senate, Universiti Kuala Lumpur, or; A Bachelor Degree in related sciences or technical field with CGPA less than 2.5 and 5 years relevant working experience as approved by Senate, Universiti Kuala Lumpur. For International Students Bachelor's in Engineering or equivalent from Universiti Kuala Lumpur with CGPA of 2.50; OR Bachelor's in related sciences or technical fields with CGPA of 2.50 from approved universities; OR CGPA below 2.50 may be accepted with 5 years of relevant work experience. IELTS 5.0, TOEFL 500 or equivalent.
